metaDescription: Order custom white golf tees for your next tournament or event. Perfect for branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: White golf tees are a classic, clean choice for tournaments and corporate outings. Their neutral color makes your logo stand out clearly, whether printed in one or multiple colors. Choose from standard 2 1/8" tees or multi-pack options like the 4-1 Golf Tee Packet to give players a convenient supply. White tees pair well with any ball marker or accessory, creating a cohesive look for your event.
